name: Air Conditioner Production Line Solution
summary: A full-line automation solution for air conditioner manufacturers, covering assembly, inspection, and packaging processes.
contentHtml:
The Air Conditioner Production Line Solution is a full-line automation solution provided by TXAM for home appliance manufacturers.

Solution Components

The full line covers heat exchanger assembly, compressor installation, pipeline connection, vacuuming, refrigerant charging, electrical wiring, and final inspection and packaging processes.

Solution Advantages

  • High level of full-line automation
  • Flexible switching for multiple models
  • Automated helium leak detection ensures sealing
  • Efficient packaging system
  • Turnkey project service

Service Content

Provides full-process support including line planning, equipment manufacturing, installation and debugging, and after-sales service.
